## Summary
One-sentence description of the feature.

## Motivation
Why does this matter? What use case does it unlock?

## Proposed implementation (optional)
If you have a concrete idea — which file to change, what interface it should have — describe it here. New dataset adapters follow the pattern in `benchmark/gold/adapters/`; new strategies follow `benchmark/memory/strategies/`.

## Alternatives considered
Any other approaches you looked at and why you ruled them out.
